text:
alex: heads up — after landing the int8 quant bring-up for magnet-small, we see divergence vs fp16 when context > 32k. repro script attached below.

nina: can you paste the exact failure log?

alex: sure. ran on a single A100, seed=42, prompt length 34_000. log:
```
ERR: kv_idx mismatch at pos 32768 (expected 0x1a2b, got 0x1a3b)
WARN: ropescale applied factor 0.999 instead of 1.0 for token >= 32768
Mismatch appears after prefill flush
```

jordan: ugh. looks like a fencepost around 32k. did we change rotary scaling threshold in the quantized path?

alex: grep shows rotary.scale_cutoff=32768 only in the int8 kernel wrapper. fp16 path doesn't have it.

kim: assigning me to run a quick bisect. is there a minimal repro? you mentioned a script?

alex: yeah: `scripts/repro/longctx_kv_repro.py --model magnet-small --quant int8 --seq 34000 --seed 42 --device cuda:0`

nina: add `--dump-kv-idx=1` to get the per-layer key indices. also try `--no-cache` to confirm it's KV cache related and not attention math.

alex: did that. with `--no-cache` outputs match fp16. with cache enabled mismatch shows up exactly when last token crosses 32768.

kv-bot: test-run: 1809998899 by alex — magnet-small / int8 / cuda:0 / seq=34000 / dump-kv-idx=1. Result: mismatch at layer 12, kv slot 32768.

jordan: layer 12 — that corresponds to the rotary wrapper we recently changed for packed int8. maybe alignment introduced an extra padding word so index arithmetic is off by 1 for large offsets.

kim: I'll reproduce on venv built from 2026-03-15 master vs 2026-03-01. schedule: running both now. ETA ~20m. leaving notes: check `kv_stride` and `kv_pack_pad` variables in runtime.cc and the int8 kernel shim.

alex: quick hack: forcing `rotary.scale_cutoff=0` in int8 path makes outputs match, but we obviously need a proper fix.

nina: good clue. that suggests conditional in wrapper triggers alternate codepath. can someone diff the fused-kernel call signatures? maybe argument ordering changed and we pass wrong buffer length for huge contexts.

kim: update: repro on 2026-03-15 matches failure, older commit (2026-03-01) does not. bisecting narrowed to: runtime: changeet 0ad4b9 -> introduced `kv_pack_pad` to optimize tile loads.

jordan: that patch did add pad for vector width; probably didn't account for rotary index math which assumes contiguous kv slots. we should either carry real_index = padded_index - pad_offset when computing rope phase, or keep contiguous logical indices for rotary math.

alex: plan: kim to open a PR with a failing unit test (create 34k prompt, assert kv_idx equal for int8 and fp16). jordan to sketch fix to adjust rotary index computation. nina will add an eval job to run long-context LLMQA on quant vs fp16 to check quality regressions once patch lands. I'll include the repro logs in the PR.

kv-bot: todo added: #ENGML-2281 create failing test + bisect results — assigned kim.

kim: creating draft PR now with reproducer and minimal test. ping me if you want to try a local patch: `git checkout -b fix/kv-pad-rope-index 0ad4b9~1 && apply patch`

nina: also let's add a nightly sweep test for contexts at 8k/32k/64k on quant builds — catching this earlier will save customers hitting regressions in Private.

alex: agreed. I'll add the nightlies to the onboarding checklist for quant models. thanks all :thumbsup:
